scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.test:db:up: docker run -d --rm --name leviaan-test-db -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -e POSTGRES_USER=postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=leviaan_test -p 55432:5432 postgres:16-alpine
